title: Minimum Consecutive Cards to Pick Up
summary: Given an integer array cards, find the minimum number of consecutive cards to pick to ensure at least one matching pair.
statement: Given an integer array cards, find the minimum number of consecutive cards to pick to ensure at least one matching pair. If no matching pair exists, return -1.
constraints: Pick one contiguous segment containing at least two equal card values.
The number picked is the inclusive segment length.
Return the minimum possible length, or -1 when every value is unique.
hints: For any repeated value, only consecutive occurrences can form its shortest enclosing segment.
Remember the latest index of each card value while scanning.
On a repeat, minimize index-latest[value]+1, then update the latest index.
Every candidate minimum ends at some occurrence and pairs with the closest prior equal value, which the map stores.
editorial: Every candidate minimum ends at some occurrence and pairs with the closest prior equal value, which the map stores.
